Method of Attack: Unauthenticated API access allowing retrieval of call recordings and entire call history by providing any user's phone number
Leaking sensitive data from cloud storage on Amazon
Attack Vector: Manipulation of app network traffic via web proxy tools (e.g., Burp, Zap) to insert arbitrary phone numbers in API requests
Exploitation of unsecured cloud storage bucket on Amazon
Indicators of Compromise: App’s cloud storage bucket on Amazon containing over 130,000 call recordings (~300 GB)
Unauthenticated API endpoints returning call recordings and call history
